ActorTalk: (Describe the scene seen in the surveillance footage)
You're saying an engineer was roaming around the Kuroros... and then they suddenly started moving and lining up...?
What should we do with it?
Let's investigate the ground. If he was lingering here, there would definitely be footprints scattered all over the floor. We can use those to track him down.
That's right, Scan Vision also has an integrated tracking protocol.
Why're you so surprised? It's normal for beta systems to have some experimental features. I'll update the privacy terms accordingly in future versions...
Anyway... let's scan the surroundings first. Maybe the suspect left behind some clues.
